name: Suou Shizuka
source:
"Recently, Iori-sama’s atmosphere has changed somewhat."

Minamoto Iori's secretary. 

He is intelligent and has a handsome face, a gentle demeanor, and is always smiling.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index9.php]official website[/url]]
